messages:
Mae (PM): quick sync: packaging for the new Marketplace/reseller path. need concrete decisions on SKU ownership, billing flow, and commission mechanics before we publish listing.
Jon (Partnerships): partners want a single SKU they can resell with a known margin. also need partner-level reporting for their customers.
Ravi (Sales): field note: many partners insist on invoicing their customers directly (reseller model). procurement wants one PO line from the partner, not us.
Claire (Eng): technical implications: we must support two billing models: direct-bill (customer -> Redwood) and reseller-bill (partner -> Redwood). for reseller-bill, we need partner ids on invoices and partner attribution in telemetry. estimate: 2 sprints for attribution + 1 sprint for invoice metadata.
Hugo (Finance): revenue recognition: reseller-bill is usually passthrough if partner takes legal ownership. We need GL code path for partner payouts and a commission schedule. proposals: fixed % rev-share vs list minus discount.
Derek (Legal): contracts: reseller agreements must include indemnity, tax handling, and export controls. if partner invoices customer, our MSA becomes a partner-supplier addendum. also need customer-facing SLA alignment language.
marketplace-bot: draft marketplace listing checklist uploaded: /marketplace/drafts/reseller-sku-checklist-2026-03-23.json
Mae (PM): proposals to decide on today:
A) "Partner SKU" - partner-resold product. Redwood issues invoice to partner, partner invoices end-customer. Commission = 25% of list on monthly collected revenue.
B) "Co-sell SKU" - Redwood invoices customer directly; partner gets referral credit paid quarterly (flat 10% on first-year revenue).
Ravi (Sales): customers in regulated sectors prefer B (Redwood direct) to avoid vendor-chain complexity. ISVs selling to SMBs prefer A for simpler procurement.
Claire (Eng): enforcement note: for A we must attribute usage to partner-subaccounts and route billing events to partner payout queue. For B only need partner tag for crediting.
Hugo (Finance): cashflow impact: A slows revenue collection by X days (depends on partner terms) and increases payout admin. B is cleaner for ARR but lower price elasticity for partners. I'll model both cases.
Derek (Legal): A adds risk: partner insolvency means potential collection gaps. need escrow or minimum guarantee clauses for large accounts. Also tax nexus issues per region.
marketplace-bot: created ticket PRO-4722 marketplace-billing-and-commission-flow
Mae (PM): Launch gating checklist draft:
- partner agreement template + resale addendum (legal)
- partner accounting flow + GL codes (finance)
- telemetry: partner attribution available in console exports (eng)
- sample invoice templates for both flows (finance/ops)
- 2 pilot partners signed and listed in marketplace (partnerships)
- marketplace listing QA and docs
Ravi (Sales): pilot candidates: IntegrateNow (reseller MSP) + EdHub (co-sell for education). I'll contact them next week.
Claire (Eng): quick proto config for attribution and billing tags:
```
partner_attr:
  partner_id: PART-123
  reseller_mode: true
  invoice_metadata:
    bill_to: partner
    partner_commission_pct: 25
```
Hugo (Finance): payout cadence question: monthly vs quarterly? monthly preferred by partners but increases ops work. propose quarterly for first 6 months then revisit.
Derek (Legal): also include a clause requiring partners to forward PO copies to Redwood within 10 days for auditability.
Mae (PM): product decision check: go-to-pilot with both A (reseller) and B (co-sell) supported but limit reseller A to partner-vetted list for GA. GA criteria: two partners live, billing accuracy >99%, commission automation in payroll, legal templates approved.
Ravi (Sales): noted. will prioritize IntegrateNow for A and EdHub for B.
Claire (Eng): I'll open RFC and schedule the 2-sprint attribution work. linking PRO-4722.
Hugo (Finance): will post ARR and cashflow scenarios by Friday and propose payout cadence.
Derek (Legal): I'll post reseller addendum draft to #legal-drafts by EOD for review.
marketplace-bot: partner portal stub created: /marketplace/partners/PART-123
Mae (PM): thanks team. action items: @Claire build partner attribution, @Hugo model payouts, @Ravi secure pilots, @Derek draft addendum. closing thread :white_check_mark:
